Stays below a quarter of max for contest words in subject or sentence-final position ('Our team is great', 'She won.'), plain counts of objects, prices, ages and birth years ('46 apples', '20 dollars', '30 years old', 'born in 1985'), and everyday narrative with no rank, result or scale reading.
